summary: Implementation plan for the TD Memory Admin Web UI. Built with FastAPI backend + vanilla HTML/CSS/JS frontend. Features: Dashboard (stats, charts, live buffer), Bot Manager (roles, tokens, start/stop), Memory Explorer (search Qdrant collections), Digest Manager (trigger/view digests), Config Editor (bot_roles.yaml, .env). Uses design system from UI/UX Pro Max: dark OLED theme, Fira Code/Sans, green accents. Served alongside the existing bot system.
